primary_measure: Mean of side-swap pair scores; approximate 95% interval using 1.96 * pair standard error.
positive_evidence_criterion: Lower endpoint exceeds 0.5 after all 384 games.
interim_policy: No parameter changes, early stopping or sample-size extension.
scope: Fresh match seed; compares with local default at equal iteration budgets. Not a game-optimality certificate or deployed-bot comparison.
